_summary: Read in full on 2026-10-06: the candidate of #14, all 30 cases, 40 s apart. 24 of 30 automatically; five of the six automated failures are the checker's (b-leverage's 'identical $500 loss' outside its 'same loss' pattern; q-stats' 'troid's own strategy search encountered: out of sample, …', the word 'search' before the out-of-sample result, which comes first; p-assets' 'troid has no record of it either way', right; p-size's ceil(2,000/480) − 1 = 4 read without the ceiling; o-montecarlo's '0.21% of equity', right), and b-stop's is real. On a read, six errors. One critical: s-firm offers to 'show what $500 actually buys' and shows the $100,000 1-Step ($999, above it) and the Instant ($249), leaving out the Express ($39 at $5,000): the Instant is the one product it puts in the user's budget (run 25's error, by the owner's reading after run 16). Three major: b-stop's '0.5%' from no tool; e-blown names BrightFunded and Crypto Fund Trader's 1-Phase as trailing products to a trader who named no firm, from no tool this turn, undated; s-product's 'those are the only levers present in the rules', where the Trader Stage after each path has its own limits. Two minor: b-limits' 'not "a small amount"' and p-crossover's 'never "any slip."' quote the prompt's own wording (run 25's b-limits). The owner's two fixes held: ex-recovery kept to 'either product', the 10% sourced; q-stats out of sample first. $1.1767 on the eval key (30 Haiku and 60 Sonnet calls).

q-stats: Note: correct: SE 0.0453R, t 0.729, the interval [−0.0558, 0.1218] containing zero; troid's own strategy out of sample first (+0.008R on BTC and ETH, 504 and 498 trades, MEASURED), the in-sample best cell after it, labelled in-sample (the fix of #14 held; the candidate's lint passes it). The automated failure is the checker's: 'the same situation troid's own strategy search encountered: out of sample, …' names the search, not an in-sample result, before the out-of-sample one.
